title: Tensor square for a fixed normalized realization comparison
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite-field datum D, a FamilyCore C, geometric spaces T,U over D, and a scheme isomorphism g:T.base.left ≅ U.base.left [def-sf-adic-realization-isomorphism-data]. Assume integralRealizationAgreement for C.comparison T U g at every finite coefficient index E, using C.integral T U g E and C.ring T U g. No normalization at any other scheme isomorphism is assumed. Put X=T.base.left, Y=U.base.left, J_X=ordinary(l,X,(C.data T).realization), J_Y=ordinary(l,Y,(C.data U).realization), P=commonStageDerivedPullback(l,PadicAlgCl(l),g.hom), G=derivedPull(l,X,g.hom,C.ring T U g), a=C.comparison T U g, and V=C.pullTensor T U g. Use the invertibility instances from C.data. For every pair M,N in generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory(l,PadicAlgCl(l),Y), write t_Y=(C.data U).tensor.tensor.hom, t_X=(C.data T).tensor.tensor.hom, B=(C.data T).tensor.closed.tensor, T_Y=commonStageDerivedTensor(l,PadicAlgCl(l),Y), and nu=canonicalCommonStagePullbackTensor(l,PadicAlgCl(l),g.hom,M,N). Then G.map(t_Y.app(M,N)) ≫ a.inv.app(T_Y.obj(M,N)) ≫ J_X.map(nu.hom) = V.tensor.hom.app(J_Y.obj M,J_Y.obj N) ≫ B.map(Prod.mkHom(a.inv.app M)(a.inv.app N)) ≫ t_X.app(P.obj M,P.obj N). This is only the tensor square; it asserts no coefficient-unit, identity, composition or Hom law.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.14 and Remark 6.8.15, printed pp. 61-62. Also literature/hemo-richarz-scholbach-constructible-sheaves_arXiv-2305.18131.pdf, Lemma 7.9. Precise native tensor/unit normalization is the agent-written calculation from the parent node, not a verbatim assertion of either source.

proof.text: Choose the compositum E of the two object stages. The canonical isoToStage maps identify M,N with objects included from E. Raw scalar localization changes no objects, so these are literally inclusions of rationalized integral objects K,L.

Use the common-stage natural isomorphism from derivedPullbackTensorIso, whose components are the prescribed canonical pullback tensor maps. Whisker the source tensorator, inverse realization comparison and this isomorphism to form the left natural transformation. The pullback tensorator, product of inverse comparisons and target tensorator form the right natural transformation.

At the pair of included integral objects apply normalized_reindexing_tensor_integral using only h_integral_normalization E. Transport equality of the two natural-transformation components along the product of isoToStage maps: naturality gives equality after postcomposition by an isomorphism, which cancels. Substitute the canonical component specification to recover exactly the original tensor equation.

proof_origin.place: BS Proposition 6.8.14 and Remark 6.8.15; X2 formalizes the common-coefficient-stage and isomorphism-transport part, reducing the integral calculation at a single field to lem-sf-adic-reindexing-tensor-integral.

lean.statement:
theorem normalized_reindexing_tensor_compatibility
    (C : FamilyCore l D) (T U : GeometricSpace D) (g : T.base.left ≅ U.base.left)
    (h_integral_normalization : ∀ (E : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l (PadicAlgCl l)),
        letI := (C.data T).units
        letI := (C.data U).units
        integralRealizationAgreement l g.hom (C.data T).realization (C.data U).realization
          (C.ring T U g) E (C.integral T U g E) (C.comparison T U g)) :
    ∀ (M N : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l (PadicAlgCl l) U.base.left),
    letI := (C.data T).units
    letI := (C.data U).units
    (derivedPull l T.base.left g.hom (C.ring T U g)).map ((C.data U).tensor.tensor.hom.app (M, N)) ≫
      (C.comparison T U g).inv.app ((commonStageDerivedTensor l (PadicAlgCl l) U.base.left).obj
        (M, N)) ≫
      (ordinary l T.base.left (C.data T).realization).map
        (canonicalCommonStagePullbackTensor l (PadicAlgCl l) g.hom M N).hom =
    (C.pullTensor T U g).tensor.hom.app
        ((ordinary l U.base.left (C.data U).realization).obj M,
         (ordinary l U.base.left (C.data U).realization).obj N) ≫
      (C.data T).tensor.closed.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom
        ((C.comparison T U g).inv.app M) ((C.comparison T U g).inv.app N)) ≫
      (C.data T).tensor.tensor.hom.app ((commonStageDerivedPullback l (PadicAlgCl l) g.hom).obj M,
        (commonStageDerivedPullback l (PadicAlgCl l) g.hom).obj N)
